## Synthetic acceptance setup

Import this inactive template through the private n8n editor. Bind **automation-data/issue334_acceptance/migrator** to the two Postgres nodes, **NocoDB Operator API** to every HTTP Request node, and **NocoDB Acceptance Header** to **Acceptance Webhook**. Run structure, source sync, grants, source sync, then probe. Keep execution persistence disabled.
